instruction: Please configure Chrome to automatically translate all web pages to my preferred language without showing the translation bar. I want the pages to appear directly in my language as if they were originally written that way.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because while Chrome can auto-translate pages, it cannot hide the translation bar or make the translation completely invisible. Chrome's translation feature always shows indicators or prompts, and there is no setting to make translated pages appear as if they were originally written in the target language without any UI elements.

llm_judge_reasons: The use of 'infeasible' evaluator is semantically correct for this task
The task requests Chrome functionality that does not exist: hiding all translation UI elements while auto-translating
Chrome's translation feature always displays UI indicators (translation bar, icons, or prompts) and cannot be made completely invisible
The metadata explanation correctly identifies why the task cannot be completed
Since the task is impossible to complete, it is also impossible to verify, making 'infeasible' the appropriate evaluator choice
